id.description: Stable identifier returned by the staged prepare upload endpoint

name.description: File name associated with the staged artifact

type.description:
Classification for the artifact

* `plan` - plan
* `context` - context
* `reference` - reference
* `output` - output
* `artifact` - artifact
* `tree_snapshot` - tree_snapshot
* `user_attachment` - user_attachment

source.description: Optional source label for the artifact, such as agent_output or user_attachment

storage_path.description: S3 object key returned by the prepare step

content_type.description: Optional MIME type recorded for the artifact
